name: Sentry MCP Server
what: Sentry's official remote MCP server, built for coding agents: it lets your AI look up Sentry issues, errors and traces and help you debug them.
who: Developers who use Sentry and want the agent to fix bugs from real error reports.

setup.text: Add the remote server https://mcp.sentry.dev/mcp to your MCP client and complete the Sentry OAuth sign-in.
Claude Code users can also install it as a plugin:
setup.code:
claude plugin marketplace add getsentry/sentry-mcp
claude plugin install sentry-mcp@sentry-mcp

setup.text: Self-hosted Sentry: run it locally instead. Note: the AI-powered search tools need an LLM provider key.

prompts: What are the top unresolved errors in my frontend project this week?
Look at this Sentry issue and suggest a fix in my code: <issue URL>
Find the traces for slow checkout requests in the last 24 hours.
